patched.notes: PAT-664: permanently vendor_only=true. Adobe trial installer (trials.adobe.com) requires cookies/session authentication; download returns 403 without a valid Adobe session. Distinct from Adobe Reader DC. Mirror pipeline will skip this label. PAT-1380 (2026-08-15): the 'alert' surfaced by catalogue-scope verification (PAT-1296) was not an Adobe/auth problem -- it was a verifier gap. The DMG downloaded clean (HTTP 200, no cookies needed for this specific static URL -- worth another look at whether vendor_only_reason still holds, left as-is here since that is a separate judgment call from this ticket) but mounted to reveal the real installer at 'Acrobat/Acrobat DC Installer.pkg', a plain named subfolder, not the DMG root or a wrapper .app -- the only two shapes _find_primary_pkg() searched before this ticket. pkgutil --check-signature hand-confirmed it: signed by Adobe Inc., Team ID JQ525L2MZD (matches expected_team_id exactly), notarized and trusted. Fixed in verifier/verify.py (_find_primary_pkg) rather than here -- extended the search to a third shape, one level into any non-.app subdirectory, requiring exactly one .pkg match. Re-run against the live URL after the fix: classification 'ok'. See PAT-1380 writeup for the reasoning on why this was safe to fix in the resolver (widens discovery only; the Team ID/notarization check downstream is unchanged) rather than left unsupported.
